scoop_tapioca.real: Scoop a spoonful of black pearl tapioca pearls from the container holding black pearl tapioca pearls with the right arm using the picked-up spoon.
scoop_tapioca.object: Pour the tapioca pearls from the spoon into the plastic cup.
scoop_tapioca.action: Place the spoon on the counter.
scoop_tapioca.direction: Lift the spoon up out of the container.

pour_dressing.real: Pour the picked-up salad dressing onto the meat slice with the left arm.
pour_dressing.object: Pour the salad dressing onto the lettuce.
pour_dressing.action: Place the salad dressing bottle on the counter.
pour_dressing.direction: Lift the salad dressing bottle up.

turn_faucet.real: Turn off the faucet with the right arm.
turn_faucet.object: Pick up the blue soap bottle.
turn_faucet.action: Place the cup into the orange basket.

twist_cap.real: Tighten the bottle cap of the held water bottle with both arms.
twist_cap.object: Pick up the cup on the far side of the table.
twist_cap.action: Place the water bottle on the table.
twist_cap.direction: Move the water bottle to the left.

stamp_form.real: Stamp the document on the table with the stamp in hand using the right arm.
stamp_form.object: Pick up the clipboard with the document.
stamp_form.action: Place the red stamp on the table.
stamp_form.direction: Slide the clipboard to the left.

scan_juice.real: Aim the barcode scanner at the barcode of the held orange juice with the right arm.
scan_juice.object: Aim the barcode scanner at the red bag of snacks.
scan_juice.action: Place the orange juice on the table.
scan_juice.direction: Move the orange juice bottle to the right, toward the scanner.

press_ricecooker.real: Press the left arm on the rice cooker.
press_ricecooker.object: Press the button on the front of the rice cooker.
press_ricecooker.action: Open the lid of the rice cooker.
press_ricecooker.direction: Push the rice cooker to the left.

press_oven.real: Press the oven start button with the right arm.
press_oven.direction: Push the oven back toward the wall.

base_turn.real: Turn to face the curtains with right.
base_turn.action: Move backward away from the window.
base_turn.direction: Turn to the left, away from the curtains.

base_forward.real: Move forward to approach the guest.
base_forward.object: Turn to the left, toward the shelves.
base_forward.action: Move backward away from the table.

move_guard.real: Move the held hand guard above the vegetable cutter with the right arm.
move_guard.action: Place the hand guard on the plate.
move_guard.direction: Move the hand guard to the left, away from the slicer.

carry_bag.real: Carry the garbage bag towards the large trash bin with the right arm.
carry_bag.object: Place the garbage bag on the bench.
carry_bag.action: Lift the garbage bag out of the bin.
carry_bag.direction: Carry the garbage bag to the left.

wave.real: Lower the left arm while waving the right arm (three times).
wave.object: Take the yellow bag from the person.

clap.action: Wave one hand at the TV.

knead_dough.real: Knead the dough with both hands.
knead_dough.action: Place the dough on the cutting board.
knead_dough.direction: Roll the dough from left to right.

cut_dough.real: Cut the dough into small pieces with a knife using both hands.
cut_dough.action: Place the knife on the cutting board.
cut_dough.direction: Push the dough pieces to the left.

shake_decanter.real: Shake the held decanter with the right arm.
shake_decanter.action: Pour the wine from the decanter into the glass.
shake_decanter.direction: Move the decanter to the left, toward the bottle.

stir_coffee.real: Stir the coffee in the cup with the spoon held in the right hand.
stir_coffee.action: Place the spoon on the table.
stir_coffee.direction: Lift the spoon up out of the cup.

tie_tieback.real: Tie the velcro curtain tiebacks with both hands.
tie_tieback.direction: Pull the curtain to the left.

untie_curtain.real: Cooperatively untie the curtain ties with both hands.
untie_curtain.direction: Pull the curtain to the right.

heldout_supermarket.real: Retrieve the small bottle of milk from the cold storage cabinet.
heldout_supermarket.object: Retrieve a bottle of yogurt from the lower shelf.
heldout_supermarket.action: Put the milk bottle into the shopping cart.

heldout_toast.real: Lift a piece of plain toast from the basket with the left arm.
heldout_toast.action: Put a slice of bread into the toaster.
heldout_toast.direction: Push the toaster to the right.

heldout_curtains.real: Pull the curtain to the level of the windowsill with the right arm.
heldout_curtains.action: Pull the curtain back up to open it.
heldout_curtains.direction: Pull the curtain to the left.

heldout_water.real: Pick up the bottled water with left arm.
heldout_water.action: Place a water bottle upright on the table next to the carton.
heldout_water.direction: Push the carton to the right.

heldout_menu.real: Carry the held red menu to the table where the guests are seated.
heldout_menu.object: Place the menu on the table.
heldout_menu.action: Hand the menu to the guest.
heldout_menu.direction: Turn to the left, away from the guest.
